corrections.why: The Forest Lookouts page for Bolinger is headed Louisiana Lookouts and gives STATE/COUNTY LA/BOSSIER. Wikipedia's list of Louisiana fire lookout towers places it in Bossier Parish. The location in the record is also in Louisiana. The county value Bossier is the parish name and is kept.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts site's Texas sidebar lists Bolinger, but the tower's own page and the NGS record both say Louisiana, Bossier Parish. The Louisiana sources are followed.

notes_for_editor: The brief has this as a Texas tower. Every source read places it in Bossier Parish, Louisiana, so the record's region is corrected to LA; the record id us-tx-bolinger is left unchanged for the editor to rename or move. Wikipedia's coordinates (32.94139, -93.73111) are about 2 km east of the record point (32.9416, -93.7523). The NGS note puts the station 2 miles west of Bolinger, which fits the record point, so the record location was left alone. The build year 1948 comes from one parish history blog; the NGS record gives no year. Wikipedia's map notes are internally inconsistent (a 1984 revision of a 1955 map, then a 1981 version), so they are not used. The Bolinger tower's own page has no height other than the NGS 'about 100 feet', which matches the record's 30.5 m.
